newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Two Philippine food stocks rise on rumours.
newsitem.headline: Two Philippine food stocks rise on rumours.

text.p: Selecta Dairy Products Inc and Vitarich Corp rose sharply by mid-morning on Thursday on rumours of a possible buy-in and the purchase of a lucrative franchise, brokers said.

Ice cream maker Selecta rose by 14 centavos, or 6.6 percent, to 2.26 pesos on rumours that it had bought the franchise of an American ice cream vendor, an analyst from a foreign investment house said.
Poultry company Vitarich Corp gained 40 centavos, or 14.04 percent, to 3.25 pesos on speculation that a United States company was looking at Vitarich for a possible buy-in.
"There has been talk before that a U.S.-based company is planning to buy into the company," the analyst added.
Officials from both companies were not immediately available to comment on the rumours.
